messages:
maria: Dropping a new compact-mode proposal for the Usage & Billing dashboard. Aim: let org admins scan 40+ projects above the fold and still find invoice download quickly. Mock: https://figma.com/... Looking for thoughts on discoverability, accessibility, and perf tradeoffs.

jonah: Compact looks great for power users. Question: how do we surface per-project invoice download without clutter? Maybe a sticky "Invoice" pill in the top-right of the page header that updates when scope changes, plus a micro-link in the card.

rebecca: Perf note: returning 40 full token histograms will bloat payloads. Plan: API returns aggregated totals + tiny sparklines (svg data url). Full day-level data fetched on demand via /projects/:id/usage-detail. Use intersection observer + keyboard focus to prefetch.

sam-a11y: a11y checklist: header pill must be focusable and announced as "Download invoice for current scope". Grid must preserve DOM order; use roving tabindex with arrow keys. For live updates use aria-live="polite" for expand/collapse messages. Also color contrast: our green delta is only 3:1 in the mock, needs to be 4.5:1 or add iconography.

maria: sticky pill + per-card micro-link sounds good. @leah how does CS feel about discoverability when customers switch org/project scope?

leah: Customers often click the breadcrumb then expect file download immediately. Recommend two things: 1) make sticky pill scope-aware and 2) show a tiny breadcrumb hint next to it like "Scope: Acme Corp / All projects". Copy: "Download invoice (CSV, month)".

oliver: Product decision: header pill = canonical CTA; per-card link = convenience. Analytics: instrument both clicks with the same event name but include scope_id and project_id. Avoid double-counting by treating header clicks as scope-level.

jonah: UI: per-card micro-link should be a subtle text-button with an icon and small hover target. For cards with many token rows, offer a "View details" flyout rather than inline expansion to avoid layout shift. Flyout should be dismissible with Esc and close on outside click.

rebecca: backend: will add X-Total-Count header on /projects/:id/usage-detail to let client decide flyout vs inline. Also will support ?prefetch=focus flag so we can load when keyboard focus hits a card. Server will stream large lists in pages.

sam-a11y: flyout must be role="dialog" aria-modal="true" and focus-trapped. Announce title like "Token details for <project>" on open. Provide keyboard pattern docs for devs.

maria: copy tweak: change label from "Tokens" to "Model tokens (inference + context)" and show currency as full locale-aware formatting. Also add small info icon with tooltip "Estimated charges include model + infra".

leah: also suggest an opt-in user preference under settings: "Default to compact usage view". Some enterprise customers prefer dense tables by default.

oliver: agree on settings. Experiment plan: gate behind feature flag dense-usage-grid; run 2-week A/B test at 2% of orgs. Primary metrics: invoice-download rate, avg projects visible per page, page load TTI, support ticket volume.

rebecca: timeline: I'll stub the lightweight APIs this week. Dev spike to validate payload sizes next Tue. Also we should include skeleton loaders for sparklines to reduce CLS.

jonah: I'll push updated frames with header pill and flyout flows and include keyboard nav diagrams.

maria: thanks everyone. If no objections I'll finalize prototype requirements EOD and start the feature flag. :rocket:
